༄༅/ /legs ldan rgyal mo'i mchod phreng bzhugs so/ /de nas legs ldan rgyal mo'i mchod phreng ni/rang nyid phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /legs ldan rgyal mo'i mchod phreng bzhugs so// de nas legs ldan rgyal mo'i mchod phreng ni/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ glo bo dge dkar gyi gtsug lag khang nas/ legs ldan rgyal mo 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa hrīḥbadz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ oṃ nā ga kro dhi shwa ri sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bh+yoḥ dam can chos skyong dkor bdag stong khams nyin byed bud med tshogs dang bcas pa la/ srid pa'i mdos chen 'di bshams pas/ sha khrag dmar gsum bdud rtsi sbyar ba'i longs spyod sna tshogs la/ ye shes dbyings dang mkha' las grub pa yi/ /sprul pa yang sprul ma lus 'khor bcas kun/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /bteg 12/ 12/ 1234/ 1234/ 1234/ bh+yoḥ rgyu sbyor lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /sdig gsum las la spyod pa mthol lo bshags/ /'gro ba'i longs spyod sna tshogs mchod par 'bul/ /dam can khyed kyi thugs dam skong gyur cig /bh+yoḥklu 'brog rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /glo bo kha rag bdud yul gshen rje'i gdong kha 'dra ba'i mchog tu/ /rdo rje'i sring gcig bsgrub cing bskong ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la/ /ser chags phal cher sder 'khrugs byed/ /skye bo dme 'thab mnol du sbyor/ /nad dang dug dang gri 'thab dang / mdze nad lhog pa mu dge 'byung / /dkor la mi 'dzem gtsug lag bshig /'dre ru dkor bdag phung bdag gnod/ /de 'dra'i dus shig shar tsam na/ /ma gcig rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /khyod la bskangs ba mang lags te/ /ser chags phal gyis khyod mi skongs/ /khyod la bsgrubs pa mang lags te/ /phreng thogs phal gyis khyod mi 'grub/ /khyod la rbad pa mang lags te/ /dam nyams rnams la rang mthu byed/ /bh+yoḥm gcig rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor don gyi bu/

/sgom ni gsal stong don la bsgoms/ /phyogs ris med pa'i rnal 'byor nga / /yang dag gtsang mi'i gnas 'dir ru/ /bsgrub cing bskang gi gshegs su gsol/ /dkar gsum mngar gyi mchod pa 'bul/ /sha chen dmar chen thang mar brdal/ /rus pa'i phung po rdza ltar lhags/ /tsit+ta'i tshogs ni ri ltar spungs/ /rak+ta'i tshogs ni mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /gsur chen dud pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /spyan gzigs longs spyo+od bsam mi khyab/ /zhal zas tshogs mchod sna tshogs 'bul/ /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /ma g.yel ma 'da' bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /ma hā maṃ sa la khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi/ ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ bh+yoḥm gcig rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /dam tshig can gyi tshe 'dzin ma/ /dam med rnams kyi srog gcod ma/ /legs nyes kun gyi btang 'dzin ma/ /glo bo gar gyi gtsug lag srung / /bstan pa gnyen po bsrung ba dang / /rnal 'byor bcol ba'iྎ /bh+yoḥm gcig rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /lta ba mtho ba'i mtho ldan ma/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i gtsang ldan ma/ /skyes mchog legs pa'i legs ldan ma/ /las rnams bsgrub pa'i sgrub ldan ma/ /mthu rtsal che ba'i che ldan ma/ /bh+yoḥsku ni gangs ri dkar po 'dra/ /dpral ba zla tshes tshes pa 'dra/ /spyan ni skar chen shar ba 'dra/ /shangs ni rgya dung bus pa 'dra/ /zhal ni pad+ma rā ga 'dra/ /tshems ni dung so dkar mo rno/ /spyan nas byams pa'i chu rgyun 'bebs/ /zhal nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bebs/ /ral pa g.yu thod mthon cing gyen du 'khyil/ /sku stod dar dkar gong nga su ru ru/ /sku smad chu dar sham bu la/ /'ja' tshon sna lnga'i thul pa sku la gsol/ /cha ga gser la rdo rje'i ris/ /phyag g.yas mnyam gzhag thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yon pa rin chen bum pa bsnams/ /zhabs la za hor l+h+wam bu mnabs/ /chibs su mchong sha yu mo chibs/ /sman bdun gong mo rol du khrid/

/mdzes pa'i na chung bdun gyis bskor/ /sman gyi bu mo klu 'brog ma/ /zhi ba dgyes pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /sman ragྎ /ma g.yelྎ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pas gter nas bton pa'o/ /bh+yoḥm gcig rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /bskal pa tha ma'i dus 'di ru/ /kun gyis las ngan spyad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi las byas rang la smin/ /bod khams sdug pa'i dus 'di ru/ /khyod kyi phrin las dus la babs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bskul ba'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing mdzod/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod/ /gtsug lag khang gi bdag po mdzod/ /bstan pa spyi yi bya ra mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bka' nyan mdzod/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyi srog shing mdzod/ /chos rgyal rnams kyi dgra lha mdzod/ /mchod cing sgrub pa'i mgon skyabs mdzod/ /rigs brgyud spel ba'i yab yum mdzod/ /lus nad sel ba'i sman pa mdzod/ /zas nor dbang sdud 'phrin las mdzod/ /snyan grags sgrog pa'i 'brug sgra mdzod/ /gzugs can dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /gzugs med bgegs kyi chags shing mdzod/ /log 'dren rnams la bdud mo mdzod/ /bdud rigs kun gyi rigs brgyud chod/ /mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma mdzod/ /dkor zan kun gyi mgul nas chings/ /mtha' yi dmag dpung bsgyur phyogs mdzod/ /glo bo dge dkar gtsug lag srungs/ /bstan pa gnyen po bsrung ba dang / /rnal 'byor ci bcol phrin las mdzod/ /dam tshig can kyi srung ma khyed/ /sman rakaྎ /ma g.yelྎ /bh+yoḥm gcig rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /ri rab ri yi rtse mo nas/ /khram bsgyur ma zhig ldem se ldem/ /khram bsgyur ri bo'i rtse la sgyur/ /khram bsgyur sdang ba'i dgra la sgyur/ /khram bsgyur gnod pa'i bgegs la sgyur/ /khram bsgyur za ba'i sri la sgyur/ /'byung po log 'dren bsgyur phyogs mdzod/ bh+yoḥbh+yoḥm gcig rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /rgya mtsho mer ba'i yang gting na/

/sho sgyur ma zhig 'jol lo lo/ /sho bsgyur rgya mtsho'i gting du sgyur/ /sho bsgyur sdang pa'i dgra la sgyur/ /sho bsgyur gnod pa'i bgegs la sgyur/ /sho bsgyur za ba'i sri la sgyur/ /'byung po log 'dren bsgyur phyogs mdzod/ /sngon nam sngon gyi dus tshod na/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /dge bar brtse mthun srung ma ru/ /khas blangs dam tshig 'di dgongs la/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnyen po srungs/ /khyod kyis bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs na/ /sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka'/ /khyod kyis yal bar 'dor nus sam/ /dus la bab bo sa mā ya/ /bcol pa'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni/ sher rgyal bdag gis dge dkar gyi zhig gsos tshar dus gnad la bor ba'i phrin las bcol ba'i phyir myur bar bris pa'o// ༈ /gtor 'bul bsdus pa ni/ pad+ma thod phreng spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /legs ldan rgyal mo la sogs pa'i/ /sku ri dkor bdag spun dgu'i tshogs/ /rgyun gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /rnga drag por brdungs la/ bh+yoḥbh+yoḥm gcig rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /ri rab rtse la bzhugs tsa na/ /khram thogs bdud kyi gtso mo ste/ /phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams/ /dkor zan dgra bo khram la thob/ /phyag g.yon sbrul nag zhags pa 'debs/ /dgra la mdze dang lhog pa thongs/ /ched ka drag tu bskul ba'i tshe/ /chibs su mdzo mo rog mo chibs/ /sku la re ba'i thul pa gsol/ /mi mgo dmar po'i chab ka btab/ /dbu la dar nag cod paṇa can/ /ma bdud 'bum gyi dmag sna drongs/ /mdzo mo bskyo la dgra bgegs thul/ /ru dar nag po dgra la phyor/ /dug gi kha rlang nag po las/ /nad dang mtshon gyi ser ba 'bebs/ /dgra la dar yams rims nad thongs/

/khyod ni shin tu mi bsrun te/ /'khor du sde brgyad dregs pa dang / /khyad par klu bdud 'brog mos bskor/ /sde brgyad dmag dpung dgra la drongs/ /gnod sbyin dug mda' dgra la rgyob/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /dbang du bsdus la rdul du rlog /mna' zan dkor zan cham la phob/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma dang / /rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ dang / /'bru bcud pañtsa a mṛ ta/ /gsang ba'i mdos chen dam pa dang / /'dod yon tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang / /rgyu 'byor yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /chag che nyams nga mchis pa bzlog /dgra 'dre bdud dang bar chad bzlog /bh+yoḥm gcig rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /dge ba rdo rje klu 'brog mo/ /ri rab chen po'i rtse mo na/ /khram thog ma gcig ldem se ldem/ /khram bsgyur sdang ba'i dgra la sgyur/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum na/ /sho bsgyur ma gcig 'jol lo lo/ /sho bsgyur sdang ba'i dgra la sgyur/ /sngon tshe sngon gyi dus tsam na/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /dge ba klu 'dul gtsug lag tu/ /rdo rje klu 'brog mthu rtsal can/ /dkor bdag rgyal mor dbang bskur nas/ /phyag na rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs/ /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa'i/ /khas blangs dam bcas mnyel lam ci/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang / /rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ dang / /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa yis/ /rdo rje legs ldan thugs dam bskang / /bh+yoḥm gcig rdo rje klu 'brog mo/ /dpyid zla gsum po shar tsam na/ /ra sa dkar po'i gshongs na bzhugs/ /'khor du brag bdud 'bum gyis bskor/ /dgra la bad mkhris mgo yor thongs/ /dbyar zla gsum po shar tsam na/ /brag dgu kye ze'i rtse ru bzhugs/ /chibs su sha pho ra bcu chibs/

/g.yon na sman brgya ldem se ldem/ /g.yas na bzod brgya sha ra ra/ /dgra la glo bur ye 'drog thongs/ /ston zla gsum po shar tsam na/ /brag dmar phug gi nang na bzhugs/ /rtse gsum 'brong gi rus gong 'dra/ /khri gdugs nyi ma lhag pa yi/ /'khor du klu btsan pho mos bskor/ /dgra la mdze dang lhog pa thongs/ /dgun zla gsum po shar tsam na/ /sgo le kha yi phug tu bzhugs/ /klu bdud klu 'brog 'khor gyis bskor/ /sbrul nag zhon pa spun dgu dang / /sbos cog 'brog mo pho nyar bcas/ /dgra la sba chen gnyen yor thongs/ /re 'ga' brag phug ngos su bzhugs/ /gtsang shod 'brog mo bran du 'khol/ /dgra la chu dri lba shas thongs/ /nam langs nyi ma shar tsam na/ /de sngon rtse nas bya ra mdzad/ /skye gnas klu dang rtse zhing rol/ /nyin ma'i gung du song tsam na/ /shugs pa rkang gcig rtsa ru bzhugs/ /lo bdud lo btsan 'khor gyis bskor/ /char pa 'bebs shing lo thog srung / /nyin ma dgong mor song tsa na/ /i li shug pa'i rtsa ru bzhugs/ /srod kyi 'khor mor song tsa na/ /gtsug lag khang la bskor bar mdzad/ /dgra bcom rnams la mchod par 'bul/ /nam gyi gung la song tsam na/ /rnam snang rtsa ru sgom par mdzad/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi don yang rtogs/ /tho rangs nam ni langs kha ru/ /klu ni 'brog mo'i chas su bzhugs/ /sku la re ba'i thul pa gsol/ /phyag g.yas bdud rtsi khram shing bsnams/ /g.yon pas ma bdud zhags pa bsnams/ /zhags pa thogs la khram la thob/ /chibs su mdzo mo ru ser chibs/ /dam nyams srog la rgyu ma g.yeng / /bstan pa srung shig dam tshig can/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ /dus la bab bo phrin las mdzod/ /shin tu gsang spyod sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ bkra shis/ zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ legs ldan rgyal mo'i mchod phreng / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
